member.name: T:LinkedIn.Shared.Infrastructure.Behaviors.ValidationBehavior`2
member.summary:
Runs every registered FluentValidation validator before the handler executes.
This fixes a real bug in the Pronia template: it registered validators with AddValidatorsFromAssembly but never wired them into the MediatR pipeline, so CreateProductCommandValidator and friends never actually ran. Registering a validator is not the same as invoking it.
